plain_summary_en: This paper studies When Populism? Consistent and Opportunistic Populist Communication in the 2022 Brazilian Presidential Elections. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Political science, Presidential system, Political economy. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
